title: Personal Checking: Overdraft Item Fees on Debits at or Below the Small-Item Threshold
content:
## Rule

A Personal Checking overdraft item fee is also a bank error when the debit that carried it is for an amount at or under the small-item threshold of the account's tier. The threshold is inclusive: a debit exactly equal to it is small enough. The test uses the amount of the debit named as the fee's source, and the threshold figure of the account's own tier.

## Judgement grid (hypothetical threshold of 4.00 USD)

| Debit amount | At or under the threshold? | Bank error on this ground |
|---|---|---|
| 3.99 | yes | yes |
| 4.00 | yes | yes |
| 4.01 | no | no |

## Basis Q&A

**Does it matter how deep the account went overdrawn?** Not for this ground; only the size of the debit itself is compared.
